title: Dominic and the Asset
author: Dominic Voss
blurb: Jonah Sandoval, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
